questions.def: Mixed conditional: past action, present result. 'would/could/might + be + -ing'

questions.def: Past unreal condition + past unreal result: 'would have + past participle'.

questions.def: Should be 'had known' to match past result (would have called).

questions.def: Past unreal condition = 'If + had + past participle', present result.

questions.def: Past unreal condition (hadn't lost), present result (wouldn't be looking).
